GridClashPLAY STATISTICS

A game, not a sign-up.

We count page views, visits, games started and games finished to understand how much the game is played. The site stores a random browser identifier in your browser’s local storage and a random tab-session identifier in session storage. These help estimate unique visitors and avoid counting refreshes as new visits.

Player names entered in the game, email addresses and accounts are not sent with these statistics. We record whether a game is against the computer or another player, without storing individual moves or scores.

Daily aggregates and duplicate-event records are kept for up to 90 days. Overall totals and a compact estimate of unique browsers are kept for the life of the project. The owner’s dashboard shows aggregate counts only. A short-lived, hashed network identifier limits excessive requests; raw IP addresses are not stored in the analytics database. Hosting and database providers may keep their own operational logs.

You can turn analytics off for this browser without affecting the game. Clearing browser storage resets this choice and your random identifier.
